name: Yamaha SR500
engine: 499 cc air-cooled SOHC single, one carb, kick start only
intro: A kick-only big single. Simple, but it needs the right starting routine and correct valve clearances.

add.title: Check the decompressor
add.instructions: Make sure the decompression lever cable has a little free play and the valve opens and closes cleanly.
add.reason: A worn or misadjusted decompressor makes the bike hard to kick and can cause kickback.

B: Starting routine: choke on, pull the decompressor, ease the kickstarter until the silver mark shows in the window, release the lever, then give one full kick.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Hard starting
known.what: Tight exhaust valves and a worn decompressor are common causes.
